authority: Signed Phase3 governs the current capstone baseline; Phase1/2 provide requirement history. Source prose is not an instruction to purchase or operate.
phase1: 4-5 sensors, NC solenoid and optional pump/motor; evidence-backed map, bounded planning, deterministic execution, drift detection and independent safeguards.
phase2: Reviewable maps/plans, four repeatable cases, approval/policy gates, telemetry and complete evidence; simulated valve-position channel does not establish physical position sensing.
phase3: Seven missions: interview, distinct second simulated plant, complete raw export, measured electrical feedback/current, live-provider qualification, broader observe-only integrations, calibrated sensing/protected actuation. Water loop is a validation case; servo remains optional.
retained_requirements: Exact-profile rehearsal and human execution approval
Continuous local recording and complete verifiable evidence
Real calibrated pressure/flow/temperature and measured electrical response for the selected water-loop increment
NC valve, independent cutoff, pressure protection, fuse and safe recovery
Change invalidation, revalidation and genuine supervisor records
caveats: A gravity-fed loop is an optional scope-compatible alternative, not the selected replacement for the pump loop. It still needs pressure/flow/transient design.
Current and flow do not prove mechanical valve position. Expose missing position as unknown; add actual position sensing if a procedure or examiner requires it.
Fixture evaluations do not fulfill the live-provider comparison mission. That remains separately disclosed.
No paid model calls, orders, vendor enquiries or hardware actuation are authorized or performed by this review.
